name: wesl-playground
description: Write, compile and preview WESL shaders in a 3D viewer shown inline in the chat.
long_description: Claude writes WESL shaders, gets compile errors back, and shows the results in a fly-through 3D viewer (Bevy, WebGPU/WebGL2) inline in the chat. Projects are plain folders on disk; groups show several variants side by side. The viewer also runs in a browser tab at https://vovac12.github.io/wesl-playground/.

port.title: Browser tab port
port.description: Local WebSocket port for the optional browser-tab viewer.

tools.name: shader_guide
tools.description: Returns the playground guide: manifest format, WESL rules, available bindings, fragment/vertex templates.

tools.name: get_project
tools.description: Get a project's manifest, file list and text file sources.

tools.name: create_project
tools.description: Create a project (manifest + shader/text files), then compile it off-screen and return errors.

tools.name: update_project
tools.description: Write/delete files and/or replace the manifest of an existing project, then compile it and return errors.

tools.name: set_group
tools.description: Create or update a group's display name, description and spacing (distance between projects when the whole group is shown).

tools.name: add_texture
tools.description: Add a texture to a project: procedural PNG, base64 image data, or a copy of a local image file.

tools.name: compile_project
tools.description: Compile a project off-screen (does not change the viewer) and return shader/asset errors plus an optional preview image.

tools.name: open_in_viewer
tools.description: Show a project, or a whole group side by side, in the user's viewer.

tools.name: screenshot
tools.description: Capture the viewer as the user currently sees it.

tools.name: viewer_state
tools.description: What the viewer is showing, its errors, and recent warnings/errors from the log.
